title: manni audience strict overlay v1.0.0
description: The strict overlay for manni:audience:1.0.0. Stack it beside the open vocabulary. It narrows the form of values the open vocabulary already claims and requires no key.

audiences.description: Strict holds each audience to kebab case, in the string form and the list form alike.

personas.description: Strict holds each persona id to kebab case, in the string form and the list form alike.

journeys.description: Strict holds each journey id to kebab case, in the string form and the list form alike.

intent.description: Strict holds the intent to a single line.

kebabOrList.description: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter or digit. It applies to a single string and to each item of a list.
